events.name: RESOLVED: Supreme Court denies government's stay application in USPS v. California, 26A305 -- mail-ballot rule stays blocked for 2026 midterms
events.reason: The Court denied the stay Monday night, finding the government unlikely to succeed on the merits; Kavanaugh concurred separately (APA 'arbitrary and capricious' given election officials' compressed timeline), Alito dissented (joined by Thomas). Both underlying injunctions (Talwani, D. Mass.; Nichols, D.D.C.) remain in effect; the rule cannot be enforced for the 2026 elections. This closes out the emergency-relief stage of the case this outlet has tracked since late July; merits litigation presumably continues in the ordinary appellate courts.
events.source: Supreme Court order, docket 26A305 (primary); CNBC, NPR, CNN, NBC News -- Confirmed-multiple

events.name: Progress MS-35 docking at ISS Poisk module -- rescheduled to Saturday, Sept 19, ~9:46 AM ET
events.reason: CORRECTED 2026-09-18 (pm): this morning's cache and report stated docking was confirmed for today, Sept 18, at 18:37 UTC (2:37 PM ET), sourced to NASASpaceFlight.com and a Wikipedia cross-check. NASA's own ISS blog, posted today, instead schedules docking for tomorrow, Saturday Sept 19, at approximately 13:46 UTC (9:46 AM ET) at Poisk's space-facing port -- consistent with Roscosmos/TASS's original estimate this system had revised away from two days ago. No docking occurred at the previously reported time. Logged as a formal correction to ledgers/corrections.json and disclosed in the 2026-09-18-pm report's Science & Space section and colophon.
events.source: NASA ISS blog (nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation), posted 2026-09-18 -- Confirmed-primary; TASS/Roscosmos -- Confirmed-multiple
